recipes.summary: A binary control that can be tapped and, when useful, dragged between off and on.
hostResponsibilities: Expose the current checked value and apply the committed change to application state.
motion: Follow the pointer while dragging, map track color from position, then spring to the nearest state.

recipes.summary: A command surface, including a floating action button, with immediate press feedback.
hostResponsibilities: Run the command on activation and preserve native button semantics.
motion: Respond immediately on press and spring back on release or cancellation.

recipes.summary: A card that communicates hover and press independently.
hostResponsibilities: Keep keyboard focus and activation semantics in the host component.
motion: Lift on hover while a parallel press region controls scale.

recipes.summary: A reversible reaction with a short expressive confirmation.
hostResponsibilities: Persist the selected value and reconcile optimistic updates.
motion: Kick scale for a physical pop, or use entry keyframes when the confirmation needs an authored multi-stage burst; on content, like with a double tap (format 0.14) and replay the burst each time.

recipes.summary: A list row that reveals contextual actions with a horizontal drag.
hostResponsibilities: Perform the action, remove the row when committed, and keep only the intended row open.
motion: Follow a resisted drag, reveal the action through a map, and snap to closed or open.

recipes.summary: A disclosure whose panel expands to measured content height.
hostResponsibilities: Expose accessible expanded state and keep hidden content out of focus order.
motion: Animate panel height to a measured value and turn the chevron; fade the content in after a short delay on opening, and out at once on closing.

recipes.summary: A horizontally draggable collection that settles on one page.
hostResponsibilities: Provide slide content, current-page semantics, and viewport measurements.
motion: Follow the drag, map indicator emphasis, and spring to the nearest page with bounded momentum.

recipes.summary: A resisted downward pull that commits refresh past a threshold.
hostResponsibilities: Start refresh on commit and send host.done when loading finishes.
motion: Apply increasing drag resistance, reveal the spinner from pull distance, hold while refreshing with the spinner on a loop, and stop it by the shortest turn.

recipes.summary: A small single-selection group with a shared moving indicator.
hostResponsibilities: Expose single-selection semantics and update application state.
motion: Move or drag one shared indicator and spring it to the selected segment.

recipes.summary: A content navigation row with an indicator measured from the selected tab.
hostResponsibilities: Provide tab semantics, focus movement, selected panel content, and layout measurements.
motion: Spring the indicator position and width to the measured selected tab.

recipes.summary: A bottom-anchored surface that follows a drag and settles at snap points.
hostResponsibilities: Manage focus, modal semantics, safe areas, scroll handoff, and viewport measurements.
motion: Follow a resisted vertical drag, map scrim opacity, and spring to the nearest snap point.

recipes.summary: A temporary message that enters, remains readable, and dismisses safely.
hostResponsibilities: Announce the message accessibly and choose a timeout appropriate to its content and actions.
motion: Enter quickly with position and opacity, wait for active reading time while pausing for hover, focus or app suspension, then leave without bounce.

recipes.summary: A short motion response that points attention to invalid input without moving layout.
hostResponsibilities: Expose the validation message and invalid semantics; never rely on motion alone.
motion: Play an authored multi-beat horizontal sequence and return to the state target; skip the transient sequence under reduced motion.

recipes.summary: A continuous value control that follows pointer movement and supports discrete keyboard steps.
hostResponsibilities: Map position to the domain value, expose range semantics, and commit changes.
motion: Follow the pointer directly while mapping fill size from thumb position.

recipes.summary: A contextual label that appears after hover or focus intent and leaves promptly.
hostResponsibilities: Place the tooltip, connect accessible description, and handle touch alternatives.
motion: Delay entry, then fade and offset gently; dismiss immediately when intent ends.

recipes.summary: A modal surface with a scrim, focus containment, and explicit dismissal paths.
hostResponsibilities: Trap and restore focus, expose dialog semantics, and remove inert background interaction.
motion: Fade the scrim and settle the dialog without a bouncy opacity transition.

recipes.summary: A voice session with connection, mute, speaking level, and leave feedback.
hostResponsibilities: Request permission, manage audio devices and transport, normalize volume to 0..1, and report lifecycle events.
motion: Map live volume to participant pulse and level while state motion confirms connection and mute changes.

recipes.summary: A video session with explicit camera, microphone, flip, connection, and leave states.
hostResponsibilities: Request permissions, attach local and remote media streams, own room signaling, switch devices, and report lifecycle events. Let a person join with unavailable devices and retry them in place.
motion: Coordinate parallel call, camera, and microphone regions so each control has independent feedback.

recipes.summary: A photo and video capture surface with mode, recording, review, retake, and flip states.
hostResponsibilities: Request permission, attach the preview stream, capture media, switch lenses, and report lifecycle events.
motion: Confirm mode changes and capture lifecycle without obscuring the live preview.

recipes.summary: An audio player with explicit loading, playback, buffering, stopped, ended, error, repeat, seek, and volume contracts.
hostResponsibilities: Own playback, seeking and volume; normalize continuous inputs to 0..1 and report lifecycle events.
motion: Map progress, buffer and volume continuously while state motion confirms lifecycle changes.

recipes.summary: A video player with playback lifecycle, progress, buffer, volume, and auto-hiding controls.
hostResponsibilities: Own media playback, seeking, volume and fullscreen; normalize inputs to 0..1 and report lifecycle events.
motion: Map playback values continuously and auto-hide controls after active time while pausing for hover, focus, scrubbing and suspension.

recipes.summary: A mobile-first header that condenses continuously with scroll position.
hostResponsibilities: Forward normalized scroll position and preserve safe-area and navigation semantics.
motion: Map scroll position to header height, title scale, and supporting-content opacity.

recipes.summary: A single-line input whose label floats out of the way, with focus and error feedback.
hostResponsibilities: Own the value and validation, report whether the field has text, associate the label and message with the input, and keep the native input semantics.
motion: Float the label while focused or filled, grow the active line on focus, and color the field and reveal the message on error.

recipes.summary: A binary or multi-select control whose box fills and whose check mark draws in.
hostResponsibilities: Keep the checked value and aria-checked in step, and support a mixed state when a parent box reflects partial selection.
motion: Fill the box quickly, pop the check mark in, clear without a pop, and sink slightly while pressed.

recipes.summary: A set of mutually exclusive options where the selected dot moves between them.
hostResponsibilities: Keep aria-checked and the roving tabindex in step, move focus with the arrow keys, and own the selected value.
motion: Grow the newly selected dot in while the previous one shrinks away.

recipes.summary: A compact selectable token that fills and makes room for a check mark when selected.
hostResponsibilities: Keep aria-pressed (filter) or radio semantics (choice) in step and apply the selection.
motion: Fill the chip and open the check mark's slot, so the chip widens smoothly.

recipes.summary: A row of stars where tapping one fills it and every star before it.
hostResponsibilities: Store the rating, expose it as a radio group or slider, and announce the chosen value.
motion: Fill the stars up to the tapped one and pop the tapped star.

recipes.summary: A small count on an icon that appears with the first item and bumps with each new one.
hostResponsibilities: Own the count and its text, cap it (99+), and include it in the icon's accessible name.
motion: Scale in on the first item, pop on each increment, and shrink away without a bounce when cleared.

recipes.summary: Dots that show which page of a pager is current, with the active dot stretched into a pill.
hostResponsibilities: Keep the current page in step with the pager and label each dot with its page.
motion: Stretch the current dot into a pill and darken it; for a dragged pager, map emphasis from its position as the carousel does.

recipes.summary: Increase and decrease buttons around a number, with feedback at the limits.
hostResponsibilities: Own the number and its limits, update the text, report each change, and expose a spinbutton or live region.
motion: Nudge the number in the direction it changed, shake it when a limit refuses the press, and dim the button that can't go further.

recipes.summary: A search button that opens into a field across the toolbar and closes back to the button.
hostResponsibilities: Move focus into the field when it opens and back to the button when it closes, clear or keep the query, and run the search.
motion: Open the bar to the toolbar's measured width while the title fades, and close it without overshoot.

recipes.summary: A list of commands that opens from an anchor and closes on choice, outside tap or Escape.
hostResponsibilities: Position the menu against the anchor and viewport, expose menu semantics, move focus into the items and back to the anchor, and run the chosen command.
motion: Grow the menu from the anchor's edge, then bring the items in with delays that grow by about 30 ms each; close faster than it opened, all at once.

recipes.summary: A floating action button that fans out related actions and turns its icon while open.
hostResponsibilities: Run the chosen action, keep focus order with the visual order, and close on outside tap or Escape.
motion: Rotate the icon at once, then reveal the actions outward from the button with growing delays, and reverse the delays on close.

recipes.summary: A collection whose items animate as they are inserted, removed or dragged into a new order.
hostResponsibilities: Play one player per row and own the items and their order: insert and remove rows, unmount a row on exit, shift neighbours while a row is dragged, pass the drop offset as host.drop, commit the new order once the drop settles, and announce changes to assistive technology.
motion: Grow new rows to their measured height and fade them in, collapse removed rows, slide neighbours by a row's height during a drag, and spring the dragged row to its slot (format 0.17 input target) before the order is committed without motion.

recipes.summary: An indeterminate indicator that turns for as long as work is in progress.
hostResponsibilities: Start and stop it with the work, delay it for quick operations, and expose busy state with a label, which is all reduced motion leaves.
motion: Fade in, rotate on a loop while the work runs, and stop by the shortest turn (wrap 360) as it fades out.

recipes.summary: Placeholder shapes that pulse or shimmer until the real content replaces them.
hostResponsibilities: Match placeholder shapes to the content layout and swap in the content when it arrives.
motion: Sweep a highlight across the placeholders' measured width on a loop, or pulse their opacity, then cross-fade to the content.

recipes.summary: Three dots in a bubble that bounce in turn while someone is composing a message.
hostResponsibilities: Report typing activity from the conversation and hide it when the message arrives.
motion: Scale the bubble in, bounce each dot on the same loop with a growing delay, and scale out.

recipes.summary: A top or bottom bar that slides away while content scrolls down and returns as soon as it scrolls up.
hostResponsibilities: Forward scroll position, keep the bar reachable by keyboard and assistive technology, and show it at the top of the content.
motion: Hide the bar by its measured height on scrolldown and reveal it on scrollup (format 0.15, which ignores wobbles under 8 units), and always show it near the top with a crossing.

recipes.summary: Screens pushed onto and popped off a stack, with an edge swipe to go back.
hostResponsibilities: Own the route stack; for each push or pop bind screen and previous to the top two screens, keep both mounted until the player settles, then unmount the popped one; move focus and the accessible title with the active screen.
motion: Slide the new screen in over the previous one, which moves a measured third of a width the other way and dims; the back swipe follows the finger and commits or cancels by where the throw was heading.

recipes.summary: A screen that slides up over the current one for a self-contained task and is dismissed down.
hostResponsibilities: Present it as a modal route, trap and restore focus, and confirm before discarding unsaved work.
motion: Slide the modal up a measured height while the presenting screen scales back and dims, mapped from the modal's position; follow a downward drag to dismiss.

recipes.summary: An element that travels from its place on one screen to its place on the next, such as a thumbnail opening into a detail view.
hostResponsibilities: Keep both screens mounted during the transition with thumb and hero as layout slots, move the real content into the card, and hand focus to the destination.
motion: Move and resize the card between the thumbnail's and the hero's measured boxes while the list fades out and the details fade in.

recipes.summary: A navigation panel that slides in from the screen edge over or alongside the content.
hostResponsibilities: Own navigation and the selected destination, trap focus while modal, and support Escape and the system back action.
motion: Follow an edge swipe or the drawer's own drag, map scrim opacity and the content's push from the drawer's position against its measured width, and settle open or closed.

recipes.summary: A full-screen image that can be pinched to zoom, panned, double-tapped and swiped down to close.
hostResponsibilities: Load the full-resolution image, clamp panning to the image bounds, and restore focus to the thumbnail on close.
motion: Scale about the pinch center, pan with momentum inside the bounds, spring back from over-zoom, and follow a downward swipe to dismiss.

gaps.need: Pinch scale and its center come from two pointers.

recipes.summary: A horizontal strip that glides after a fling and may settle on an item edge.
hostResponsibilities: Provide item content and measurements, and keep keyboard and screen-reader scrolling working.
motion: Follow the drag, then glide (format 0.16) with the release velocity, travelling velocity × momentum and settling with the spring at either measured end; for stopping on an item edge, use the carousel's nearest with the same momentum.
